Description.DefaultText: Hidden anti-collapse sequencer for the Inn Keeper's weekly onboarding beats: 0 = Week-2 line not yet heard (it gates on step 0 AND week >= 2), 1 = Week-2 heard (Week-3 backstory gates on step 1 AND week >= 3), 2 = Week-3 heard. Catch-up players binge at most one beat per conversation; backfilled to 2 on old saves that already received the Well Plans.
